verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs say it is a self-hosted web app and document Docker Compose (recommended), npm, and Kubernetes Helm installs, plus remote deployment guides and self-managed configuration via librechat.yaml and .env. Community users confirm hands-on that it was quite easy to install and that they run it for personal use. Acquisition worries are speculation and do not contradict this. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, and evidence that every core feature is available in self-hosted deployments with no paid-tier gating.
